verdict.rationale: Sentry publishes an API reference on docs.sentry.io (e.g. the 'Bulk Mutate a List of Issues' endpoint page), so a browsable reference exists. Nothing in the evidence shows it is interactive or offers runnable examples, and probes for a machine-readable OpenAPI spec at standard docs paths all returned 404. Missing for 10: evidence of an interactive try-it console, runnable code examples, a discoverable OpenAPI spec, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
